label: Fixed initial history and possibility transfer: inclusion edge and frugality assessed
summary: Composed FixedInitial535 History with PossibilityTransfer. Four-history equivalence-frame structural surrogate: a same-description, different-initial-bearer history and a different-description history are E-possible but not M-possible under the rigid reading; the qualitative reading admits bearer omission and bearer 0 is not necessary there. The history-2 separations presuppose bearer-distinct qualitative duplicates (OPEN; anti-haecceitist individuation identifies histories 0 and 2). Restricted inclusion on one description's witnesses suffices for its transfer and is strictly weaker than full inclusion; for a complete history description transfer is equivalent to one access edge. Rigid preservation, an E-admitted bearer omission and restricted inclusion are jointly inconsistent; the rigid profile also denies the single existential edge (one E-admitted, M-accessible history lacking the actual initial bearer), which the qualitative surrogate profile has while failing restricted inclusion. Rigid plus full inclusion makes some actual initial bearer E-necessary. Re-read pinned Oppy 2020 §I p.14, §VI pp.19-20 and §VII p.21. Frugality (analyst reconstruction; Oppy 2013 attribution unverified) is a comparative theory-choice reason, not a definitional exclusion; its force needs an unsupplied rule counting possibilities rather than necessities as commitments (Oppy §VII puts necessity on each balance sheet). Modal austerity gives no differential against theism at this node by Oppy's §VI-VII reasoning; his §IV fewer-commitments argument (kinds of causes) and §VII trumping claim are not assessed. Practice treating initial conditions as explanatory targets supports E-admissibility only. Rejected: conceivability alone refutes fixed history; origin essentialism forces or forbids alternative starts; universal restricted inclusion as the discriminating premise (repaired after semantic challenge). Deferred: a disambiguation record for the rigid/qualitative readings of shared initial history (follow-up under #216); the frozen Challenge docstring of rigidTriad still says it composes propagation, superseded by the Solution docstring. Full assessment in docs/notes/fixed-initial-history-535.md, section Issue #1588.
blocker: No warranted account of metaphysical access for initial histories: the discriminating premise is the single existential edge (some E-admitted history lacking the actual initial bearer is M-accessible), which the rigid profile denies; universal restricted inclusion is only a sufficient strengthening. Its surrogate witness presupposes bearer-distinct qualitative duplicates (OPEN). Oppy's part-or-aspect case needs its own edge; no accounting rule for modal commitments is defended.
